programme.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
programme.desc: After hearing a series of negative reports, Romesh explores Haiti to discover whether his preconceptions about the Caribbean country are correct.

programme.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
programme.desc: For years all that most people in Britain have heard about Ethiopia is famine. Now, comedian Romesh Ranganathan is heading to East Africa to discover if this reputation is justified.

programme.title: Frozen Planet II
programme.desc: Antarctica is the most hostile of all Earth's frozen worlds. Yet even here, amongst some of the most challenging conditions on the planet, life finds a way not just to survive, but thrive.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Sue tries to hunt primitively and Andy takes the new puppies to his sled team. Meanwhile, the Hailstones take baby Wade to snare rabbits.

programme.title: Secrets of the Superagers
programme.desc: The filmmaker chronicles a scientist's journey across the world interviewing people who defy aging and provide essential tips on how to lead a lengthier and healthier life.

programme.title: Big Cats 24/7
programme.desc: Competition for food becomes fierce as lion numbers rise, a lioness risks her life to feed her five cubs and a Xudum's newborn leopard cubs face a fatal threat.

programme.title: Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa

programme.title: Tan- Badan
programme.desc: A spoilt young man wants to marry the girl of his dreams, but instead he has to marry an innocent village girl who knows nothing of the intimate relationship between a husband and wife.

programme.title: Raaj Tilak
programme.desc: A king is cheated by his own men and his newborn son ends up in a gypsy camp. Several years later, when a substitute prince, Shamsher, inflicts atrocities on the royal family, the lost prince returns.

programme.title: Yaarana
programme.desc: Childhood friends Bishan and Kishan are separated by Bishan's uncle. However, Bishan helps Kishan to become a successful singer, and Kishan uses his skills to restore Bishan's lost fortune.

programme.title: Aurat Teri Yehi Kahani
programme.desc: Savitri, a motherless girl, is forced to marry an elderly man for her family's sake. However, after her husband's sudden death, her life takes a turn for the worse.

programme.title: Agni Sakshi

programme.title: Kshatriya
programme.desc: Two royal families in Rajasthan fight annually to fulfil an age-old tradition. Unaware of the clash, their grandsons become best friends and attempt to end the family feud.

programme.title: Gardish
programme.desc: Purshottam, a policeman, wishes for his son, Shiva, to become a police inspector. However, when he gets attacked by mobsters, the latter resorts to violence and crime.
